description: Gmail API - Complete email management with SMART bundled tools for AI-powered composition, bulk operations, inbox organization, and intelligent processing

tools.name: gmail_ai_smart_compose_and_send
tools.description: 🤖 SMART TOOL: AI-powered email composition and sending in ONE call. Takes natural language prompt, generates professional email, and sends or creates draft. Optionally creates Google Calendar events from email content. Use this instead of manually writing emails.

prompt.description: Natural language description of what to write. Examples: 'Follow up with John about yesterday's product launch meeting', 'Thank the team for Q4 performance', 'Apologize to customer for order #12345 delay'

recipients.description: List of email addresses to send to

send_immediately.description: If true, sends email. If false, creates draft for review.

create_calendar_event.description: If true, extracts date/time from email and creates Google Calendar event

use_cases: Send AI-generated follow-up emails
Compose and send meeting requests with calendar events
Create professional apology/thank you emails
Draft emails for review before sending

tools.name: gmail_smart_bulk_send_personalized
tools.description: 📧 SMART TOOL: Send personalized bulk emails with mail merge in ONE call. Each recipient gets customized email with their specific data ({{name}}, {{order_id}}, etc.). Perfect for mass outreach, reports, invoices, onboarding.

template.description: Email body template with {{variables}}. Example: 'Hi {{name}}, your order {{order_id}} is ready! Total: ${{amount}}'

recipients_data.description: Array of recipient objects with email and variables. Example: [{'email': 'john@co.com', 'name': 'John', 'order_id': '12345', 'amount': '99.99'}]

subject_template.description: Email subject with {{variables}}. Example: 'Your Order {{order_id}} Update'

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait between sends (avoid rate limits)

use_cases: Send 50 customers their personalized invoices
Email team members their individual performance reports
Send new hires their custom onboarding instructions
Bulk outreach with personalized content
Mass newsletter with recipient-specific data
tools.efficiency: 98% reduction in tool calls (50 calls → 1 call)

tools.name: gmail_smart_bulk_read_summarize_prioritize
tools.description: 📖 SMART TOOL: Bulk read, summarize, and prioritize emails in ONE call. AI analyzes multiple emails, generates summaries, assigns priority scores (1-5), recommends actions, and optionally creates Google Spreadsheet with results. Perfect for inbox triage.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to process

summarize.description: Generate AI summaries for each email

create_spreadsheet.description: Create Google Sheets with results and recommended actions

returns.emails: array of {message_id, from, subject, date, summary, priority, recommended_action, labels}

use_cases: Process 200 unread emails and identify urgent ones
Summarize all emails from clients this week
Read emails with attachments and prioritize
Create spreadsheet of inbox with recommended actions
Triage support emails by priority

tools.name: gmail_smart_auto_reply_draft_creator
tools.description: 💬 SMART TOOL: Auto-generate reply drafts for multiple emails in ONE call. AI analyzes emails and creates appropriate responses based on content and response type. Creates drafts for review or returns generated text.

message_ids.description: List of Gmail message IDs to reply to

custom_instructions.description: Additional instructions for AI. Example: 'Mention our support hours are 9-5 EST'

create_drafts.description: If true, creates drafts in Gmail. If false, just returns generated text.

returns.replies: array of {original_message_id, original_subject, original_from, generated_reply, draft_id}

use_cases: Create reply drafts for all support emails
Auto-respond to meeting requests with availability
Generate acknowledgment replies for customer orders
Draft responses to all unread client emails
Batch create replies for common inquiries

tools.name: gmail_smart_inbox_organizer_cleaner
tools.description: 🗂️ SMART TOOL: Organize, clean, and auto-filter inbox in ONE call. Creates labels, applies filters, archives old emails, deletes spam, and organizes messages automatically. Perfect for inbox zero workflows.

process_existing.description: Apply rules to existing emails (not just future ones)

archive_older_than_days.description: Archive emails older than N days

delete_spam.description: Permanently delete emails in Spam folder

use_cases: Organize inbox - create labels and filter emails
Clean up inbox - archive old emails, delete spam
Set up auto-labeling for client/team emails
Create filters for newsletters and automated emails
Achieve inbox zero with automated organization

tools.name: gmail_send_email
tools.description: Send an email with attachments and HTML formatting

tools.name: gmail_get_message
tools.description: Get a specific message by ID

usage_guide.smart_tools_overview: Gmail SMART tools bundle multiple operations into single AI-powered calls for maximum efficiency.

decision_tree.composing_email: Use gmail_ai_smart_compose_and_send - AI writes professional emails from natural language
decision_tree.bulk_personalized_send: Use gmail_smart_bulk_send_personalized - Send customized emails to multiple recipients with mail merge
decision_tree.inbox_triage: Use gmail_smart_bulk_read_summarize_prioritize - AI analyzes, summarizes, and prioritizes emails
decision_tree.auto_replies: Use gmail_smart_auto_reply_draft_creator - AI generates appropriate replies for multiple emails
decision_tree.inbox_organization: Use gmail_smart_inbox_organizer_cleaner - Auto-create labels, filters, and organize inbox
